title: Practice 5: с-: down, and together — раз-: apart

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Тома ___ (развести / разводить) через фальшивый аккаунт в соцсетях.
exercises.why: **развести́** — **разводи́ть** — to take along, to bring; to conduct; to part, to move apart, to pull apart, to separate. **развезти́** — **развози́ть** — to deliver, to transport (multiple people or things to their respective destinations); (colloquial, impersonal). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: развести́** — **разводи́ть — to take along, to bring; to conduct; to part, to move apart, to pull apart, to separate.

exercises.why: **развести́** — **разводи́ть** — to take along, to bring; to conduct; to part, to move apart, to pull apart, to separate. **развезти́** — **развози́ть** — to deliver, to transport (multiple people or things to their respective destinations); (colloquial, impersonal). — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Рональд Рейган попросил Горбачёва "___ (снести / сносить) эту стену".
exercises.why: **снести́** — **сноси́ть** — to carry down; to carry to. **свести́** — **своди́ть** — to lead, to take (from somewhere); to bring together, to throw together. **свезти́** — **свози́ть** — (perfective only, transitive) to transport, to drive, to convey; (colloquial, perfective only, transitive) to transport there and back, to drive there and back. **сле́зть** — **слеза́ть** — to come down, to get down (from), to dismount (from); (colloquial) to come down. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: Ronald Reagan asked Gorbachev to "tear down this wall".
exercises.context: снести́** — **сноси́ть — to carry down; to carry to.

exercises.q: After some freight cars were derailed, services were suspended on the Chuo Line.
exercises.why: The prefix "с-" implies the following meanings: (a) to descend, to go down: Мы съезжаем с горы. Он сходит вниз по лестнице. (b) to come off, to drive off: Автомобиль съехал с дороги. Поезд сошёл с пути. Note that these verbs (сходить, съезжать, etc.) are usually followed by the preposition с + Gen. Wiktionary's two entries for «сходить»: сходи́ть • (sxodítʹ) impf (perfective сойти́) — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; to come off, to disappear; сходи́ть • (sxodítʹ) impf (perfective сойти́) — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; to come off, to disappear. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.ru: Грузовые вагоны ___ с рельсов, и движение поездов на линии Тюо было приостановлено.
exercises.context: The prefix "с-" implies the following meanings: (a) to descend, to go down: Мы съезжаем с горы. (DLI, Lesson 63)

exercises.q: Дети дуют на одуванчики, чтобы увидеть, как семена ___ (разлетаться / разлететься) по ветру.
exercises.why: **разлете́ться** — **разлета́ться** — to fly away, to scatter (in the air); to come apart, to be blown apart. **разбежа́ться** — **разбега́ться** — to scatter; to take a run, to run up (before jumping, diving, etc). **разнести́** — **разноси́ть** — to carry, to convey, to deliver; (colloquial) (news, rumor etc) to spread around. **развести́** — **разводи́ть** — to take along, to bring; to conduct; to part, to move apart, to pull apart, to separate. — DLI, Lesson 63.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: The children blow dandelions to see the seeds disperse on the wind.
exercises.context: разлете́ться** — **разлета́ться — to fly away, to scatter (in the air); to come apart, to be blown apart.

exercises.q: Грузовые вагоны ___ (сойти / сходить) с рельсов, и движение поездов на линии Тюо было приостановлено.
exercises.why: Wiktionary's two entries for «сходить»: сходи́ть • (sxodítʹ) impf (perfective сойти́) — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; to come off, to disappear; сходи́ть • (sxodítʹ) impf (perfective сойти́) — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; to come off, to disappear. **сойти́** — **сходи́ть** — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; (figuratively) to come off, to disappear, to go from. — Wiktionary, «сходить» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/сходить, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.prompt: After some freight cars were derailed, services were suspended on the Chuo Line.
exercises.context: Wiktionary's two entries for «сходить»: сходи́ть • (sxodítʹ) impf (perfective сойти́) — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; to come off, to disappear; сходи́ть • (sxodítʹ) impf (perfective сойти́) — to go down, to come down, to descend,…

exercises.q: И ___ (расползаться — to crawl away) дом.
exercises.why: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "**с**": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "**-ся**" the verb **встречать** — **встретить** is used with the direct object in the Accusative case: *Вчера я встретил моего друга.* but: *Мы встретились на улице.* We already know that the verbs in "**-ся**" may be divided into several groups. Verbs which never occur without the ending "**-ся**": *Я боюсь вашего брата.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 66–67.  ·  From Юрий Тынянов, «Смерть Вазир-Мухтара».
exercises.context: The second actor (if mentioned) is always in the Instrumental case with the preposition "**с**": *Я не хочу встречаться с этим человеком.* Note that without "**-ся**" the verb **встречать** — **встретить** is used with the direct object in the Accusative…

exercises.q: На вот, ___ (снести / сносить — to carry down).
exercises.why: Antonym: вз- — После представления актёр сошёл со сцены. — After the performance, the actor got off the stage. — с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst.. **с-, со- (+сь, +ся)** — Convergent movement from various directions towards one center. Antonym: раз-, разо-, рас- (+сь, +ся) — Чтобы заниматься, студентка снесла все учебники из других комнат на письменный стол. — In order to study, the student brought all her textbooks from other rooms to her desk. — Wikipedia, «Russian grammar» (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Russian_grammar#Verbs_of_motion, CC BY-SA 4.0)  ·  From Владимир Короленко, «История моего современника».
exercises.context: Antonym: вз- — После представления актёр сошёл со сцены. — After the performance, the actor got off the stage. — с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst..
